changes.to: Issue #17 (2026-11-17): Calvin-40 - Wandercraft's site describes the industrial humanoid and its 40 kg handling but publishes no table of height, mass, DoF or speed, so the figures here come from third-party cataloguing of Wandercraft's material and the record stays unconfirmed. [replaced height_mm: None -> 1700; weight_kg: None -> 80; max_speed_mps: None -> 0.83; dof: None -> 28; runtime_h: None -> 4.0]

Wandercraft's Calvin page publishes no height, weight, DoF, payload, runtime, battery or price (checked 2026-11-17): it states high-torque motors, a 3D sensor with an AI vision stack, autonomous navigation, a certifiable safety system for use without physical barriers, a target failure rate below 1 in 1,000 and first series delivery expected in H1 2027. The name refers to a 40 kg handling capability, but no figure is stated on the page, so the spec fields are left empty.

changes.from: Full-size humanoid from Wandercraft; b2b only, sold to businesses.
changes.to: Wandercraft's first industrial humanoid: a headless biped built on the self-balancing platform of its medical exoskeletons, for heavy handling and flow logistics in factories and warehouses.
